root_cause: The offcanvas component disables focus trap when the scroll configuration is true (data-bs-scroll="true"), allowing focus to leave the panel when tabbing.
repair_strategy: Ensure focus trap is always activated when the offcanvas is shown, regardless of scroll setting, by removing the conditional check in the show callback.
expected_accessibility_effect: Tab navigation will remain trapped within the offcanvas panel, allowing users to navigate focusable elements inside without escaping to underlying page.
functional_risks: Potential conflict with scroll=true intent (though focus trap does not affect scrolling).
verification_requirements: After opening help panel, first Tab focuses #help-close.
Second Tab keeps focus inside panel (loops to #help-close or other focusable elements).
Offcanvas can still be dismissed via Escape, close button, or backdrop click.
Body scrolling behavior respects data-bs-scroll setting.
